summary_1line: Lakshmana poetically describes the arrival of winter in the forest and reflects on nature’s changes and Bharata’s austere devotion to Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: At dawn on the misty Godavari, Rama walks to bathe while Lakshmana carries a water pitcher and Sita follows beside them.
A wild elephant touches the frozen river with its trunk and recoils while cranes and waterfowl hesitate on the icy bank.
Fields of barley and wheat glitter with frost in the rising sun as cranes call across the mist-covered woodland.
